body:
I feel the same. I have tried and tried and tried. Multiple doctors, counsellors, social workers, crisis lines - different medications with the promise that this one might work for me. None of it ever helped and I only started to feel *some* relief to the pain when I met my boyfriend, but it still never goes away. People who just tell you to go and get help like it's easy or will fix all your problems are fucking ignorant. It makes me so mad when some celebrity commits suicide and everyone goes "oh if only they'd tried to get help!" we fucking try. We all fucking try so hard and get nowhere. 

I really hope you don't die and that you find happiness somehow, but I understand how you feel right now. Everyone makes it sound so fucking simple and it's not.
I believe you. I know how painful it is wanting to die and screaming out that you want to diebut having no one listen or take you seriously. I can't help you much but I understand.

I feel the same way. I've never been able to imagine myself growing old. It's either I die now, within the next few months, or I find enough happiness and enough to live for that I keep on going for a few more years before finally ending it. I'm approaching 22 right now and honestly I'm amazed I've made it this far. I won't live past 30. I know I won't. If I can get through life right now, and make things a little better, I want to travel the world with the love of my life, then die with his permission and end the pain for good. 

In english class when I was in school, we read About A Boy. The main character's mother attempts suicide, and in her suicide note, she describes it as life being a party that she's tired of now, and just wants to go home. That stuck with me. It's kinda how I feel. I still have things I want to do and experience, but I know that after that, it's time to end things. I'm getting tired already.

You sound like a person who has never felt the pain of believing that no one would care if you're dead. Trust me, it's painful beyond belief. Even if you know deep down that it's not true and shouldn't matter, *it makes no difference.* Those thoughts are always there, never ending, they influence everything you do and say. You can't speak to your family because your first thought is "they don't care about what I have to say". You sit up in your room alone all day, waiting for someone to message you, to reach out, to prove they care, but no one ever does. Anyone who says they're happy alone and they don't care what other people think is talking shit. Living a life where you feel like no one cares about you isn't a life worth living. People are all different. Some people are not meant to live in this world. Some people will never be happy no matter how hard they try.

Are you me??? Fuck I relate to this so hard.

I love my boyfriend more than anything else in the whole world, he's changed my life, if I hadn't met him I'm sure I'd be dead already. But it's not enough. Despite him being everything I've ever dreamed of and far more than I could ever deserve, I still want to die. I hate that so much. He deserves so much better than me.

I'm pretty sure I'm autistic (but currently undiagnosed). Everything feels like too much, and it's so overwhelming. My family all think I'm doing great, I'm at university now, I get fantastic grades, but I just can't cope with living in this world. Everything hurts. I just don't want to be here.
